description: This file defines an Angular module called LoginModule, which imports necessary Angular Material modules, declares the LoginComponent, and provides a configuration for the LOGIN_API_BASE token using a factory function.

classes.name: LoginModule
classes.description: An Angular module that bundles together components, dependencies, and providers related to the login feature.

methods.name: factory function in providers
methods.description: Provides the LOGIN_API_BASE token value, attempting to access window.NG_APP_API_BASE with fallbacks for server-side rendering or errors.
